subject.title: feat(browser): add secure per-tab copilot panel

question: Should `toolBindings` become a generic plugin-tool context contract for capability-bound runs, or should the browser copilot keep tab binding behind a narrower browser-owned SDK seam?
rationale: This choice determines the permanent plugin compatibility and security boundary; source review can identify the risk but cannot choose the repository’s intended external contract.

options.title: Approve a typed generic contract
options.body: Keep a generic run-binding seam only with explicit owner approval, a documented binding schema, compatibility tests, and clear limits on which plugins may consume it.

options.title: Keep the binding browser-owned
options.body: Remove the broad plugin-context surface and expose only the narrow browser capability required by this bundled extension.

options.title: Pause the feature boundary
options.body: Hold the PR until maintainers choose the long-term plugin and Gateway capability model for tab-bound execution.

recommendation.title: Approve a typed generic contract
recommendation.body: Keep a generic run-binding seam only with explicit owner approval, a documented binding schema, compatibility tests, and clear limits on which plugins may consume it.

likelyOwner.reason: The current branch implements the proposed protocol and plugin-context boundary across the browser and Gateway surfaces.
